tagline.en: Oahu's one urban freeway, and the busiest road in Hawaii
tagline.zh: 瓦胡岛唯一的城市高速，夏威夷最繁忙的道路

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: Route 93 (Farrington Highway) at the Palailai interchange, Kapolei, Oahu
start.zh: 瓦胡岛卡波雷伊，帕莱莱互通，与 Route 93（法灵顿公路）相接

end.en: Route 72 (Kalanianaole Highway) at Ainakoa Avenue, Honolulu
end.zh: 檀香山，Ainakoa 大道处，与 Route 72（卡拉尼亚纳奥莱公路）相接

en: H-1 runs the length of Oahu's developed south shore, from the industrial west end at Kapolei, past Pearl Harbor and the airport, through downtown Honolulu and Waikiki's inland edge, and out to Kahala where it hands off to a surface highway. Everything on the island's populated side is reached from it, and there is no parallel freeway.

That makes it unusually load-bearing for a road of its length. Commuters from the growing west side, airport and harbour freight, tourist traffic, and the military bases along Pearl Harbor all share the same pavement, and the corridor is boxed in between the Koolau foothills and the coast with very little room to widen.

It also does not look like a mainland Interstate. Interchanges are close together, some ramps are short and tight, and long stretches were built to standards that predate the Interstate designation entirely.
zh: H-1 纵贯瓦胡岛已开发的南岸：西起卡波雷伊的工业区一端，经珍珠港与机场，穿过檀香山市中心与威基基的内陆边缘，一直到卡哈拉，再把车流交给一条平面公路。岛上有人烟的一侧，所有地方都靠它抵达，而且没有第二条平行的高速公路。
这使得它以其长度而言承担了异常沉重的负荷。西部新兴住区的通勤者、机场与港口的货运、游客车流，以及珍珠港沿线各军事基地的交通，全都共用同一段路面；而这条走廊被夹在科奥劳山麓与海岸之间，几乎没有拓宽的余地。
它看上去也不像美国本土的州际公路：互通间距很近，有些匝道又短又急，还有很长的路段是按早于州际公路编号的标准修建的。

en: The road began as the Mauka Arterial, a territorial project planned in 1952 as a six-lane divided crosstown highway with grade separations, intended to lift Honolulu's east–west traffic over the north–south streets. Its first section opened on 9 November 1953 and was described at the time as the highest standard of highway construction yet seen in the islands.

Hawaii had been left out of the 1956 Federal-Aid Highway Act because it bordered no other state. The Hawaii Omnibus Act of July 1960 brought it into the federal-aid Interstate programme, using the national-defence justification added to the law in 1957 — the highways would link Pearl Harbor, Schofield Barracks and the Marine Corps air station at Kaneohe Bay.

The Lunalilo Freeway, as the Mauka Arterial had been renamed, was designated H-1 in March 1965, and the plan was extended west to Palailai near Barbers Point. The last piece, a short section between Nimitz Highway and the Moanalua Freeway, opened in 1986, completing the route in its present form.
zh: 这条路最初叫 Mauka Arterial（山侧干道），是 1952 年规划的准州工程：一条设有立体交叉的六车道分隔式横贯市区公路，目的是把檀香山的东西向交通抬升到南北向街道之上。首段于 1953 年 11 月 9 日通车，当时被形容为岛上所见最高标准的公路工程。
由于不与任何其他州接壤，夏威夷被排除在 1956 年《联邦资助公路法》之外。1960 年 7 月的《夏威夷综合法案》将其纳入联邦资助的州际公路计划，依据是 1957 年加入法律的国防理由——这些公路将连接珍珠港、斯科菲尔德兵营与卡内奥赫湾的海军陆战队航空站。
Mauka Arterial 更名后称卢纳利洛高速，于 1965 年 3 月被定名为 H-1，规划并向西延伸至巴伯斯角附近的帕莱莱。最后一段是尼米兹公路与莫阿纳卢阿高速之间的一小段，于 1986 年通车，本路线遂成今日之形。

en: H-1 is the busiest road in Hawaii. The heaviest counts are not downtown but on the Pearl City–Aiea stretch, where westbound commuters, airport traffic and the Pearl Harbor bases converge on the same lanes.

Because there is no alternate freeway, an incident on H-1 has no relief valve: traffic diverts onto Kamehameha Highway or Nimitz Highway, both of which are surface arterials with signals. Hawaii DOT collects volumes at permanent counting stations, overhead cameras and temporary tube counters, and publishes them by station rather than by route.
zh: H-1 是夏威夷最繁忙的道路。流量最高的路段并不在市中心，而在珍珠城—阿耶亚一带：西行通勤者、机场车流与珍珠港各基地的交通在同一批车道上汇合。
由于没有可替代的高速公路，H-1 上发生事故时没有泄压阀：车流只能转向卡美哈梅哈公路或尼米兹公路，而这两条都是设有信号灯的平面干道。夏威夷州交通部通过固定观测站、高架摄像机与临时管式计数器采集流量，并按观测站而非按路线发布。

why.en: No public route-wide figure was located. H-1 was built in stages over more than thirty years, beginning as a territorial arterial before Hawaii was eligible for Interstate funding, and its costs were recorded contract by contract.
why.zh: 未查到公开的全线数据。H-1 分阶段修建，前后逾三十年，起初是在夏威夷尚无资格获得州际公路拨款时作为准州干道兴建，其费用按合同逐项记录。

label.zh: 夏威夷的交通量统计方式

timeline.en: The first section of the Mauka Arterial opens in Honolulu on 9 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 9 日，Mauka Arterial 首段在檀香山通车。

timeline.en: The Hawaii Omnibus Act brings Hawaii into the federal-aid Interstate programme.
timeline.zh: 《夏威夷综合法案》将夏威夷纳入联邦资助的州际公路计划。

timeline.en: The Lunalilo Freeway is designated H-1 and the route is extended west toward Barbers Point.
timeline.zh: 卢纳利洛高速被定名为 H-1，路线向西延伸至巴伯斯角方向。

timeline.en: The last section, between Nimitz Highway and the Moanalua Freeway, opens.
timeline.zh: 尼米兹公路与莫阿纳卢阿高速之间的最后一段通车。
